name: directory
title: Diocese of Norwich List of Parishes (March 6, 2026)
command: pnpm diocese roster import norwich directory scratch/norwich-map-1/001-survey/dl/directory.json
notes: pdftotext -layout of the PDF linked as 'List of Parishes' from /Find/Parish-Communities (pages dated March 6, 2026), parsed by scratch/norwich-map-1/tools/norwich_parishlist.py then norwich_directory_fix.py. One entry per church block; kind Closed where the list says Closed; group = canonical parish ('Merged with') or yoked set ('Yoked with'). The Pawcatuck block repeats St. Mary, Stonington and St. Thomas More; those repeats were dropped. Addresses parsed, some hand-set (LINE1 in the fix script).
